headline: Executive order on giving state and local governments a larger role in preparing for emergencies and disasters.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how the country prepares for emergencies such as disasters. It appears aimed at putting more of that preparedness work in the hands of state and local governments, with efficiency as a stated goal. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and programs involved are not clear from this source.

who_it_affects.how: They may be expected to take on more responsibility for emergency and disaster preparedness.
Their role in disaster preparedness may change, though the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 18, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available material.
